messages:
Ravi: Who keeps stealing the good office stapler? Asking for a friend. :raised_hand:
Tina: Not me. But I did see Omar holding it like a trophy earlier. :eyes:
Omar: Guilty. Its vintage. I promise to return it after I finish 'stapling practice'. :sweat_smile:
Nora: Can we get a community stapler with a tiny name tag? Also a sticker that says 'Stapler Steward'.
BuildBot: FYI: maintenance request created #789 (auto).
Ravi: Stapler-stealing consequences: coffee run for a week? :coffee:
Omar: Deal. Also will replace with better stapler. Sorry team.
Tina: Mystery solved. Also suggestion: 'Office Essentials Fair' next Wed? Swap gadgets, pens, snacks.
Nora: Love that. I will bring my extra desk plant cuttings.
Ravi: Plant swap + stapler restitution party. Who's bringing snacks?
Tina: I can bring cookies.
Omar: I will bring a brand new stapler and apologies.
BuildBot: Reminder posted to #general: Office Essentials Fair, Wed 3pm.
